Mira's Saturday class is the Tumbleweeds toddler gym class — she started it back in September 2024 and it's been her regular Saturday activity since.

Recent activity logs also show her enjoying parent-and-tot swim on a rotating basis, so if gym time has shifted to swim lately, it's worth double-checking with whoever's been dropping her off. Want me to check your calendar for what's actually on the books this Saturday?
